title: Next CVU and UrbanToronto 2026 Walking Tour August 18
summary:
UrbanToronto has partnered with the Council on Vertical Urbanism (CVU, formerly the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat) for a 2026 walking tour series. The Transit+Towers: Transit-Oriented Development in Toronto public tours travel along the Yonge corridor from Union Station to Midtown, exploring how subway infrastructure and high-rise development have combined to transform Toronto over more than seven decades.

Organized by CVU’s Canada office, the evening series runs from late May through October, inviting both industry professionals and city-curious residents to experience the city during active hours. Guided stops combine historical insight
